opening.argument: The presentation offers a plan promising a 6% daily profit, stating that "your total return will be 150% with your deposit back." It also ties greater affiliate status to commissions of up to 10% and visibly presents a three-tier affiliate structure with 3%, 2%, and 1% levels. The scheme connects participation to Bitcoin deposits, profit withdrawals, and recruitment-based earnings. Although it references investment in crypto-mining equipment, it does not specify a paid mining or node product tied to mining returns; the central offer remains rapid, fixed returns linked to deposits and audience participation.
